name: ConciUrges
source:
The customer is always right~!

But that doesn't mean that they're necessarily pleasant to deal with.

After a horrible escape to the local Pleasure Palace, AphroDesia, you've come to stand before TMon, the acting general manager, to report your grievances concerning his establishment.

[From [url=https://snaccpop-studios.itch.io/conciurges]itch.io[/url]]

Stars TMon from the AphroDesia audio drama series.
